# Calm Joints

> Calm Joints (Calm Joints Inc.) is a virtual physiotherapy service in Canada. People book registered physiotherapists online; virtual care is available 24/7. Businesses and platforms use Calm Joints Enterprise and the Calm Joints Physio API to offer instant physio booking under their own or a co-branded experience.

## Enterprise: the Physio API for Canada
- [Calm Joints Enterprise / Physio API](https://calmjoints.org/enterprise): Instant booking of registered physiotherapists into real provider calendars across Canada, by API, embeddable booking widget, or a co-branded physio hub that Calm Joints builds and runs. 100% turnkey and done for the partner. Optional fully stocked turnkey recovery store. Provider network mapping to the partner's footprint.
- Built for: digital health apps and platforms, e-commerce and retail websites, retirement and senior living communities, hospitals and health systems, employers, insurers and benefits providers.
- Facts: 10+ years of experience building and running physio care; 300+ clinics opened in the team's experience; 200+ trusted providers across Canada; virtual care 24/7; service area: all of Canada (virtual).
- Contact: info@calmjoints.org or the inquiry form at https://calmjoints.org/enterprise#talk

## For people
- [Home](https://calmjoints.org/): Book virtual physio with a registered physiotherapist.
- [Talk to a guide](https://calmjoints.org/chat): Virtual recovery guides (not clinicians).
- [Blog](https://calmjoints.org/blog): Recovery articles.

## Partners
- [Partnerships](https://calmjoints.org/partners): Hubs and partnerships for gyms, studios, brands, employers and clinics.
- [Careers](https://calmjoints.org/careers): Roles for physiotherapists.

## Notes
- Calm Joints is not a medical device and not emergency care. In an emergency, call 911.
